pr_title: Expand number piece for legacy old skins
pr_body:
- Expand number piece for legacy skin that are older than v2.0
- This matches behaviour with stable: [Reference from wiki](https://osu.ppy.sh/help/wiki/Skinning/skin.ini#1.0).
- [x] Depends on #6450 

Closes #5537
pr_comments: The version code is all over the place. `DefaultSkinConfiguration` should probably not take a string, so maybe use that as a starting point.

Just want to bump this, as this visual difference makes lazer gameplay feel different from stable, probably what this player and maybe others are noticing.
![osu!_obnFx7lGdt](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35318437/88471151-48de7980-ceba-11ea-92a9-168baabde04f.png)

As for my review, the fade out of the number should also be different between the two versions. The linked issue's (https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/5537) description gives a good visual of that. Just not sure what that duration is.
Will bump this into the next milestone

> As for my review, the fade out of the number should also be different between the two versions. The linked issue's (#5537) description gives a good visual of that. Just not sure what that duration is. @Joehuu Right, couldn't do per-frame comparisons at the time I opened PR (should've mentioned that in the description...), here's how it currently looks (slowed down): ([video](https://streamable.com/il2tqn)) After applying a fade out with quarter the legacy duration (`60.0`), it would look exactly like osu!stable: ([video](https://streamable.com/p0xb7l)) But now that `ExpandNumberPiece` shouldn't only stop scaling, but applies immediate fading to the number piece, I'll discard the whole lookup and put the version check inside the legacy piece itself (as a condition to decide between whether to scale, or immediately fade)

issue_context.title: Circle Expand Version issue (numbers expands)
issue_context.body:
Circle expand from lazer version issue, that one use from like version 1:
![expand lazer](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/53025167/62157957-a1625180-b30e-11e9-98eb-db787a073d0f.png)
Osu Stable with skin.ini Version 2.0+:
![expand stable](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/53025167/62158004-c0f97a00-b30e-11e9-8895-879d4d54914f.png)

Same Skin and that use verison: 2 or latest
Skin: Clear Skin Ultra 3.0 (https://osu.ppy.sh/community/forums/topics/606260)
Same issue with another skins.

osu!lazer version: 2019.730.0
Logs: none
comments: Is this an issue? I was aware of this when implementing this, but it looked better with the number expanding to me. Would appreciate more detail on why you prefer it not expand.

My personal preference: circle expand without numbers expand (I find it more comfortable for me.)

Mostly people like without numbers expand (without numbers expand are less distracting, is personal preference). And WubWoofWolf or another people like that "insta fade" (like WubWoofWolf Skin use default numbers as hitcircle - can't be use combo colors, without expand) I think that one can be config on skin.ini if supported, like example this:

Example:
CircleExpand: 1 or 0 (sould be use circle expand or not?)
NumbersExpand: 1 or 0 (only worked if CircleExpand is set to 1)

Please dont take us the possibility to change the fadeing. In my opinion as a skinner it would be great if we could costumize the fadeout time in skin.ini. I always played without the animation with only default0-9.png as hitcircle and i dont want to miss it. This also would solve the problem with numbers above 10 (stacking default pngs/numbers). So the ajustment in skin.ini would solve all problems and fit for every player i guess.

And it would make alot of skins out there right now playable for me :D

~~I'm actually a bit confused here, so the issue is that `NumbersExpand` is ignored?~~ Just realized `NumbersExpand` doesn't exist..

I honestly prefer without numbers expanding, but would be better to add it as a settings option whether numbers should expand or not with default of false.

review_comments: because of value changed bindings. I think it's safer to bind value changed events in `LoadComplete`?
I don't follow, what isn't used by them?
The thing this comment is attached to. I'm not sure how to be more clear.
oh, you meant the `drawableObject` being resolved with the attribute, I thought you meant why I moved the bindings, sorry, will return back.
